name: 44303 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44303 (Akron) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44303 (Akron) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44303 (Akron) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
